prompt: Hibernate XML mapping node attribute dot period format
answer:
In Hibernate XML mappings, the `node` attribute uses a period (`"."`) to map to the **parent element**.

```xml
<map name="accounts" node="." embed-xml="true">
```

The supported formats are:

- `"element-name"` — map to the named XML element
- `"@attribute-name"` — map to the named XML attribute
- `"."` — map to the parent element
- `"element-name/@attribute-name"` — map to the named attribute of the named element
